Work-queue badge reads "Open notices · earliest due first" while the card subtitle says "Newest first" and rows are ordered by issue date (due 19 Oct, 03 Nov, —, 11 Oct …), so the most urgent items are not at the top.

The Exposure tile's "22 matters" counts open notices with an amount of demand, not litigation matters, and its ₹4.23 cr disagrees with Litigation MIS (₹3.68 cr total exposure across 9 open matters) — two "exposure" figures with different bases.

Due-in-7 tile counts 12 (open, extended due date) while its drill-down ?filter=due7 lists 10 (raw due_date, includes closed, and drops notices due today once UTC midnight has passed) — see findings/drilldown-counts.json.

At 390 px the module tab bar (Dashboard · Work Queue · Matters · Hearings · Clients · Reports) neither wraps nor scrolls, so every page carrying it renders ~481–485 px wide (sideways page scroll, cards clipped at the right); large ₹ amounts also overflow their tiles (Litigation MIS, matter Outstanding). Alert emails: both queue paths set staff_name to the recipient, so the shell signs "Warm regards, <recipient's own name>"; internal staff alerts open "Dear <client name>,"; the body adds a second sign-off ("-- V.
